verdict.rationale: Maritime documents a RESTful API for managing agents programmatically, authenticated with bearer `mk_` keys. It serves a live OpenAPI 3.1 spec and Swagger UI at api.maritime.sh, backed by TypeScript/Python SDKs and a documented Files API. The 404s on maritime.sh paths do not contradict this, because the spec lives at the API origin. missing for 10: an API versioning or deprecation policy (the spec is at 0.1.0 and mixes internal host-events paths into the public surface), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the API in use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: RESTful API for managing agents programmatically.
Mint a personal API key with `maritime keys create` and send it as a Bearer token, the same token the CLI itself uses.
Maritime serves a live OpenAPI 3.1 document at the API origin (info title "Maritime API")
with in-page request execution against the real API using a bearer key
